job: Show the reader-facing hand-off from an original chat into a visibly separate seller-sponsored shopping conversation without implying neutrality, endorsement, safety, privacy, purchase completion or wider availability.
scene: People-free adult editorial pop-art still life on a shopping desk. A tablet displays two clearly separate blank interface panels, one receding and one foregrounded, with only geometric empty chat-bubble shapes and no text. Beside it sit a bright desk lamp, a flexible measuring tape and a simple product-page card with blank blocks.
mustShow: Two visibly separate blank conversation panels
mustNotShow: Readable text, letters, numbers or pseudo-text
Prices, ratings, checkmarks, badges or purchase confirmation
Global maps, tier labels or availability claims

style.authority: LAiDIES current adult editorial pop-art direction
style.palette: Navy and plum linework with cyan, pink, coral and yellow accents.
style.finish: Crisp editorial composition, halftone print texture, strong silhouette, clean negative space; no UI realism or glossy tech advertising.

output.alt: An illustrated tablet shows two separate blank chat panels beside a desk lamp and a measuring tape.
